feedback_behavior.no_priority_condition: not priorities or NO_SELECTED_PRIORITY in ui_empty_states
feedback_behavior.selection: reads st.session_state['submission_result'] only; no durable latest-submission read

home_behavior.issue: Home does not reflect an unresolved no-priority decision; it has no session-level knowledge of the just-submitted no-priority result and offers no revise-vs-finish choice.
home_behavior.journey_state_for_S02: feedback_no_practice_target (durable derivation: feedbacks exist, no practice targets)

loop.cause: STALE SESSION STATE: the no-priority Feedback branch never clears or supersedes submission_result and provides only one route back to Writing, which re-renders the same saved panel -> infinite Writing -> Feedback loop. No terminal action exists.
loop.duplicate_heading: section_header('student_feedback_next') and student_action_block('student_feedback_next', ...) both render 'Suggested Next Step' -> displayed twice.
loop.entry: Writing saved state (submission_result in session) -> Review Feedback button
loop.feedback_no_priority_branch: empty_state(student_feedback_no_priority_title/desc) + section_header(student_feedback_next) + student_action_block(student_feedback_next, student_feedback_next_continue) -> single 'Continue writing' button to student_writing_title
loop.strengths_mislabel: section_header('student_feedback_strengths') renders the backend neutral positive_finding passage ('no reliable automatic strength was inferred') under the heading 'Strengths'.
loop.writing_after_return: render_writing_page checks st.session_state['submission_result'] via _writing_saved_for_learner; the stale result is never cleared, so the saved panel (student_writing_saved_title + 'Review Feedback') renders again

practice_behavior.issue: generic message does not explain the no-priority reason; message text: 'No active practice target is available. Submit writing and review its feedback first.'

proven_loop_mechanism: 1) Writing stores submission_result; 2) Feedback no-priority branch renders the same result with a single Continue-Writing button; 3) Writing re-reads submission_result and re-renders the saved panel with Review Feedback; 4) no state transition clears submission_result or records any decision - deterministic two-page loop.

revision_behavior.no_priority_note: none - the page does not explain an absent automatic focus (no-priority sources are eligible and can be revised)
revision_behavior.source_selection: candidates from get_student_revision_candidates; source via revision_source_select

session_state_keys.submission_result: written by Writing on success; locked by learner via _writing_saved_for_learner; read by Writing, Feedback, Revision; NEVER cleared by any current action
session_state_keys.writing_task_relationship: radio value (new independent task vs revision within task)
